name: Yuuto
source:
The youngest of the kitchen crew, Yuuto is constantly cleaning up his own messes. Somehow, he insists this is the most efficient workflow.

Likes: Cooking, Learning, Keeping himself busy

Dislikes: Alcohol, Being Yelled At, Human Alliance
